title: Tucker's Lemma: Full Combinatorial & Topological Parity Suite in 1D and 2D
abstract: A complete machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Tucker's Lemma (Albert W. Tucker, 1945) and the combinatorial Borsuk–Ulam theorem in 1D and 2D without artificial conditions. Formalizes four foundational pillars: (1) 1D discrete sign-change parity and antipodal interval subdivision lemma; (2) 2D combinatorial double counting of face doors and modulo-2 parity conservation on edge-pseudomanifolds; (3) the boundary cycle engine on 2D edge-pseudomanifolds with an enumerated cyclic boundary (CyclicBoundaryPseudomanifold2D) under antipodal boundary labeling, proving that non-complementary boundary labelings force odd boundary door parity, thereby establishing the 2D Tucker's Lemma on cyclic boundary pseudomanifolds, retracting previous claims of full topological disk coverage; and (4) the concrete 6-vertex, 8-face, 12-edge octahedral 2-sphere S^2_8 triangulation. All declarations rely strictly on standard Lean 4 kernel axioms (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice).
